<page>
Watson & Hines LLP
Pearland, TX
Phone 832-555-6543
Letter of Representation
10 Dec 2023
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1056
Our client: Timothy Middleton
Date of loss: 4 Nov 2023
Dear Claims Representative:
This firm represents the individual injured in the motor vehicle collision described in the enclosed file materials. The
client sustained injuries in a low-speed head-on impact and is currently receiving medical care. Effective immediately,
all communication regarding this claim, including requests for statements, medical authorizations, or settlement
discussions, must be directed to this office and not to our client. Please confirm in writing that you have made a note
of this instruction on your claim file.
We also request that you provide a complete copy of the policy declarations page, including all liability coverage limits
and any applicable excess or umbrella coverage that may apply to the insured driver. Please identify every policy
under which coverage may be available so that we can evaluate the claim properly.
Finally, we ask that your company preserve all evidence related to this incident. This includes photographs, vehicle
inspection reports, telematics or event data recorder information, recorded statements, adjuster notes, and any
communications with other parties. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal procedures that could affect
these materials. We look forward to your prompt written response.
Sincerely,
Susan Johnson
Watson & Hines LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
